summary: A Yes vote authorizes the San Diego Unified School District to issue $3,500,000,000 in general obligation bonds to repair and upgrade school facilities across the district.

tax.text: A Yes vote supports a bond measure for upgrades and repairs at district schools without raising taxes.
tax.quote: This November, voters living in the San Diego Unified School District will have the opportunity to support Measure M, a bond measure that will continue ongoing upgrades and repairs across nearly 150 of our schools… without raising taxes!

schools.text: A Yes vote supports funding upgrades and repairs across nearly 150 San Diego Unified schools.
schools.quote: This November, voters living in the San Diego Unified School District will have the opportunity to support Measure M, a bond measure that will continue ongoing upgrades and repairs across nearly 150 of our schools… without raising taxes!

tax.text: A No vote does not approve the bond measure or its proposed school upgrades and repairs.
